be5e097ffea7b50c.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة تكوين للصناعات المعدنية عن مشغل آلة درفلة معادن للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تشغيل آلات درفلة المعادن لثني أو نشر المنتجات المعدنية، مع ضمان جودة وسلامة الإنتاج. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل آلات بثق المعادن والتحقق من مطابقة المنتج للمواصفات الفنية. القيام بعمليات تفتيش روتينية للصيانة الوقائية للكشف عن الأضرار والتلفيات في الأجزاء، وتحديد المشاكل واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. تنظيف المعدات وإجراء الصيانة الأساسية. الإبلاغ عن الأعطال لفنيي الصيانة أو الميكانيكيين، والاحتفاظ بسجل للأعمال المنجزة. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في تشغيل آلات درفلة المعادن أو مجال مشابه. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المواصفات الفنية للمنتجات المعدنية. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات الصيانة الوقائية الأساسية للمعدات. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة في مدينة الرياض، ضمن بيئة عمل صناعية تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الحضور المنتظم في موقع العمل. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

be85d6beb4e299f0.description: About the Role Saudia Dairy & Foodstuff Company (SADAFCO) is seeking a Pre-Salesman - Ambient to join their team in Abha. This full-time role is essential for executing pre-sales calls according to journey plans, aiming to achieve sales targets by selling all available SKUs to customers and ensuring product availability, visibility, and replenishment. Key Responsibilities Follow designated Journey Plans, ensuring no call exceptions or non-buying customers. Develop and refine routes by reporting new outlet openings and closings to the Sales Supervisor. Provide customers with suggested orders to maximize SKU availability by following recommended order guidelines. Record accurate stock levels for all relevant SKUs in each outlet. Replenish and display products according to merchandising policy to increase shelf space and off-take. Ensure effective utilization and maintenance of company assets (Chillers/Freezers), strictly prohibiting non-SADAFCO products. Report maintenance issues and any misuse of assets by customers to supervisors immediately. Ensure Point of Sales (POS) materials are displayed in outlets as per company policy. Oversee proper delivery of goods by the delivery team and collect payments according to terms. Ensure all Temporary Credit (TC) invoices are collected within the TC credit policy and properly filed with the relevant supervisor. Review and sign returned products from stores upon receipt and reconcile them with the storekeeper upon return from the market. Manage stock in stores and backrooms to prevent bad returns and damaged products. Complete all sales-related administration accurately and on time. Ensure daily collections are deposited with the cashier in a timely manner. Sync orders for delivery on the next working day using the Mobile Sales Force Application (MSFA) after returning from the market. Complete daily MSFA endorsement with the supervisor, discussing daily activity, market development opportunities, sales achievement against targets, and other KPIs. Professional Conduct and Appearance The Pre-Salesman is expected to maintain a professional image at all times, representing SADAFCO. This includes ensuring the designated vehicle is clean inside and out, and that personal grooming and uniform adhere to company standards. Qualifications and Experience Minimum High School diploma. 3-5 years of relevant experience. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Abha.

be4db40170192c19.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أصل العناية للعلاج الطبيعي عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في خميس مشيط، عسير. يركز هذا الدور على إدارة المستندات المالية، متابعة الإيرادات، إعداد القيود المحاسبية، وتدقيق الحسابات البنكية لضمان دقة وسلامة العمليات المالية للشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. متابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها بشكل دوري. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات المخصصة. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من اكتمال شروطها القانونية والمالية. معرفة قوية بمبادئ المحاسبة وإجراءاتها. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تنظيمية عالية لإعداد وتوثيق المستندات المالية. القدرة على تحليل البيانات المالية وإعداد التقارير بدقة. الالتزام بتطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة خميس مشيط بمنطقة عسير. سيعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق مالي لدعم العمليات التشغيلية للشركة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة أصل العناية للعلاج الطبيعي.

be7a84d9d35ecee2.description: About Abdul Latif Jameel Abdul Latif Jameel is a diversified business comprising independent entities engaged in various sectors, including automotive distribution, financial services, renewable energy, and real estate development. Established in 1945, the group operates in 30 countries and employs approximately 11,000 individuals from over 40 nationalities. The term Abdul Latif Jameel refers to a group of distinct and separate legal entities rather than a single corporate entity. The Opportunity: Stock Management Supervisor Abdul Latif Jameel is seeking a Stock Management Supervisor to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires 5-10 years of experience and involves overseeing various administrative and operational functions to ensure efficient center engagement and facility management. Key Responsibilities Manage day-to-day transactions related to center engagement event activities and procurement requests across departments. Provide procurement services within the center and remote areas, including detailing with all units, offering necessary orientation for associates, and consolidating purchasing requisitions in a timely manner. Visit government sectors such as civil defense, municipalities, and the Ministry of Commerce to obtain required licenses and permits. Monitor all center construction and maintenance projects, coordinating effectively with the projects department. Oversee center fixed assets, including maintenance, purchasing, and inventory management. Supervise and coordinate activities with safety and security companies. Manage contractors’ administration requests, manpower, and agency contracts. Approve and authorize expenditures or actions for administrative operational needs based on the manual of authority, escalating matters requiring higher approval and signatures as necessary. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Demonstrated ability to manage complex administrative and operational tasks. Experience in procurement, facility management, and coordination with external entities. Work Conditions The Stock Management Supervisor will work a standard schedule of 48 hours per week.

be8c2bae411d8cc7.description: About the Co-op Program Emdad By Elm is seeking motivated Co-op trainees to join its team in Jeddah, Makkah. This internship opportunity is designed for students from Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, and other related technical disciplines. The program provides hands-on experience in various technical areas within a professional setting. Role Overview The IT Co-op role offers practical exposure to software development, programming, technical solutions, and project coordination. Trainees will work alongside experienced professionals, contributing to real projects and developing both technical and professional skills in a collaborative environment. This program is intended to bridge academic knowledge with practical industry experience. Key Learning Areas Gaining practical experience in software development methodologies. Participating in programming tasks and technical problem-solving. Assisting in the implementation of technical solutions. Supporting project coordination activities within a team. Developing professional skills through collaboration with experienced staff. Candidate Requirements Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's Degree program in a technical or IT-related field. Eligible for a Co-op Training Program through their university. Available to complete a training duration of 4-6 months. Demonstrated passion for learning and developing technical competencies. Willingness to complete the training program in Jeddah. Location and Duration This Co-op opportunity is based in Jeddah, Makkah. The required training duration is between 4 to 6 months, providing a structured period for skill development and practical application within Emdad By Elm.

be8db46b6564cd90.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركه السعوديه للكهرباء والتبريد للاستثمار عن مهندس سلامة وصحة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على إعداد وتطوير أسس وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية في مواقع العمل، وتحديد الأخطار المحتملة، وضمان توفير واستخدام مستلزمات السلامة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد وتطوير أسس وإجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية، مثل سياسات السلامة وتعليمات العمل الآمن والإخلاء، ومتابعة اعتمادها والالتزام بها. تحديد الأخطار الميكانيكية والكهربائية والكيميائية في مواقع العمل ووضع الإشارات والملصقات التحذيرية اللازمة. إعداد قوائم بمواصفات وكميات معدات ومستلزمات السلامة والصحة المهنية، ومتابعة توفيرها وضمان التزام العاملين باستخدامها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال السلامة والصحة المهنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال السلامة والصحة المهنية. القدرة على إعداد وتطوير أسس وقواعد وإجراءات السلامة. مهارات تحديد الأخطار المهنية ووضع إجراءات تفاديها. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مكة المكرمة، وتتطلب العمل ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة وصحية. ملخص الدور يتولى مهندس السلامة والصحة المهنية مسؤولية شاملة عن تطوير وتنفيذ برامج السلامة، ومراقبة الالتزام بالمعايير، وتقديم الدعم الفني لضمان بيئة عمل خالية من المخاطر. معلومات إضافية المسمى الوظيفي: مهندس سلامة وصحة مهنية الشركة: الشركه السعوديه للكهرباء والتبريد للاستثمار الموقع: مكة المكرمة نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه

beb510534d7f2bba.description: About the Tamheer Opportunity Abdullah Hashim Co. Ltd is offering a Tamheer opportunity for a Marketing Specialist in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is designed for motivated individuals seeking to gain hands-on experience and develop their skills within the marketing field. Role Overview The Marketing Specialist will contribute to the development and execution of marketing initiatives. This position provides an opportunity to work across various marketing functions, including strategy, content creation, market research, and event coordination, supporting the company's overall marketing objectives. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute marketing strategies and campaigns across digital and traditional channels. Conduct market research, analyze campaign performance, and provide actionable insights. Create and manage marketing content, ensuring brand consistency across all platforms. Coordinate promotional events and product launches. Collaborate with internal teams and external partners on marketing initiatives. Manage the marketing budget and maintain digital platforms. Support the sales team with various marketing initiatives. Candidate Profile We are seeking candidates who are motivated and detail-oriented, with a strong desire to grow and acquire practical experience in marketing. The ideal candidate will be eager to learn and contribute to a dynamic team environment. Qualifications and Experience Experience required: 0-1 years. Eagerness to gain hands-on experience in the Marketing field. Strong motivation and attention to detail. Work Setting This is a full-time Tamheer opportunity based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role offers a professional environment for career development in marketing.

bebe808f963bdb38.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إيلاف نجد عن مساعد إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في حائل. يركز هذا الدور على دعم الرئيس المباشر في المهام الإدارية اليومية، بما في ذلك تنظيم المراسلات، إدارة المواعيد، وتنسيق الاجتماعات لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ التعليمات الإدارية الصادرة عن الرئيس المباشر ومتابعة القرارات الإدارية. فتح وفرز البريد الورقي وتوزيعه على الأقسام المعنية. إدارة البريد الإلكتروني والرد عليه وفقاً لتوجيهات الرئيس المباشر. القيام بأعمال الطباعة والرد على الاستفسارات والمكالمات الهاتفية. تنظيم وحفظ الملفات والمعاملات بطريقة تسهل الرجوع إليها. تنسيق وتنظيم اجتماعات الرئيس المباشر واجتماعات موظفي الوحدة التنظيمية. المشاركة في الاجتماعات وتدوين وتوثيق محاضرها. طباعة وتوزيع محاضر الاجتماعات الخاصة بالرئيس المباشر على الأطراف المشاركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على متابعة تنفيذ القرارات الإدارية بكفاءة. مهارات تنظيمية عالية لإدارة البريد والمواعيد والملفات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة، شفهية وكتابية. القدرة على التعامل مع المهام المتعددة وتحديد الأولويات. إتقان استخدام برامج الحاسب الآلي المكتبية. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إنجاز الأعمال الإدارية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة حائل، وتتطلب التواجد في مقر الشركة. سيعمل المساعد الإداري ضمن فريق داعم، وستكون مسؤولياته محورية في دعم العمليات اليومية للرئيس المباشر والوحدة التنظيمية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة إيلاف نجد.

bed9920425ed4e11.description: About the Role The Royal Commission for Jubail and Yanbu is seeking a Registered Nurse to join their team in Al Jubail. This full-time position involves providing safe, patient and family-focused quality care, utilizing the nursing process, and contributing to the strategic goals of Nursing Services and the hospital. The role requires 1-2 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Provide individualized patient care according to nursing standards, policies, and evidence-based practice. Act as an advocate for patients and their families. Demonstrate transcultural principles in nursing practice. Assess, plan, implement, and evaluate patient care using the Nursing Process upon admission, each shift, and with changes in patient condition. Educate patients and families based on assessment findings. Administer medications, narcotics, controlled drugs, and infusions strictly with a physician’s order. Utilize SBAR for clear, comprehensive, and relevant reporting during nurse assignment changes. Serve as in-charge when assigned, demonstrating leadership competencies. Enter charges for services and supplies into the system and assist with stock control. Serve as a resource and role model to colleagues, participating in teaching, training, and development of nursing staff. Assist physicians with approved specialized procedures according to their privileges. Document all relevant information accurately, clearly, legibly, and in a timely manner. Report complaints, incidents, equipment failures, safety and security issues, and supply inventory reductions to the Unit Nursing Supervisor. Report incidents using the IR reporting system. Promote a safe environment and patient care by embracing a safety culture and identifying risks. Comply with policies for personal and patient safety and for the prevention of healthcare-associated infections. Qualifications and Requirements Must be classified or classifiable by the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties (SCFHS). 1-2 years of relevant experience. Professional Conduct The Registered Nurse is expected to display a positive approach towards the program, hospital, colleagues, and patients, while providing high-quality care. This role also involves welcoming and supporting new staff and students, and contributing to staff retention. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Jubail, within a hospital setting that prioritizes patient and family-focused care, safety, and continuous improvement.

befe96fefe035d57.description: About Badhrah Investment Company Badhrah Investment Company is a Saudi startup based in Buraydah, Al-Qassim. The company focuses on various investment opportunities within the region. Role Summary Badhrah Investment Company is seeking a Graphic Designer & Video Editor to join their team in Buraydah. This full-time role involves creating high-quality visual and multimedia content, transforming complex information into engaging visual stories. The position is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Develop infographics, digital designs, and presentations. Create short-form videos and motion graphics. Produce other multimedia content as required. Transform technical, commercial, and project-related information into compelling visual narratives. Design content for social media, marketing campaigns, investor and client presentations, project reports, and internal communications. Collaborate with management, marketing, project, and site teams. Required Skills and Experience Strong design judgment. Practical video-editing skills. Ability to work effectively in a fast-moving startup environment. 0-1 years of relevant experience. Work Environment The successful candidate will operate within a dynamic startup environment, requiring close collaboration with various internal teams to achieve project objectives. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this full-time position in Buraydah.

be3365fa919c9cef.description: About the Role Westin Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Sales Coordinator for a contract position in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role supports the Sales & Marketing department by performing general office duties and preparing sales-related documents. The Sales Coordinator will also serve as a primary point of contact for clients, ensuring efficient communication and support throughout the sales process. Key Responsibilities Perform general office duties including filing, sending emails, typing, faxing, and copying to support the Sales & Marketing team. Prepare sales-related documents such as proposals, contracts, and banquet event orders throughout the sales process. Promote awareness of the brand image both internally and externally. Gather materials and assemble information packages, including brochures and promotional materials. Utilize sales techniques to maximize revenue while maintaining existing guest loyalty to Marriott. Enter, retrieve, reconcile, and verify information (*, commissions, leads, third parties) within sales software. Answer guest questions regarding property facilities and services, including hours of operation, rates, room types, packages, promotions, entertainment, restaurants, and special events. Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, communicating with them via phone and email to respond to questions and requests. Operational Duties and Professional Conduct Adhere to all company policies and procedures, ensuring a clean and professional uniform and personal appearance. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipating and addressing service needs, and expressing genuine appreciation. Communicate clearly and professionally, preparing and reviewing written documents accurately and completely, and answering telephones with appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues, supporting the team to achieve common goals, and responding appropriately to concerns. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Perform physical tasks such as moving, lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, and placing objects weighing up to 10 pounds without assistance. Execute other reasonable job duties as requested by supervisors. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 0-1 years of relevant experience is required for this position. Work Type and Location This is a contract position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. be449ddaf82e976f.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث فندق فرج المدينة الفندقية عن مندوب مشتريات للانضمام إلى فريقه في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة عمليات الشراء، بدءاً من تحديد الاحتياجات وحتى استلام المواد وتدقيق المطالبات المالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المشتريات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طلبات الشراء الواردة من الجهات المعنية وتدقيقها لضمان توافقها مع اللوائح التنظيمية للمشتريات. تنفيذ عمليات الشراء المباشر للمواد والسلع المختلفة وفقاً للإجراءات واللوائح المعتمدة. تجهيز وثائق المناقصات وتوزيعها على الموردين المحتملين، وجمع عروض التوريد المقدمة. تشكيل فرق لدراسة العروض ومتابعة عملها، بالإضافة إلى تدقيق نتائج الدراسة لضمان الدقة والعدالة. إرساء طلبات الشراء على العروض الأكثر ملاءمة بناءً على اللوائح والتنظيمات المعمول بها. استلام المشتريات والتحقق من مطابقة الكميات والمواصفات المطلوبة. تدقيق المطالبات المالية المتعلقة بالمشتريات لضمان صحتها وتوافقها مع العقود. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المشتريات أو سلسلة التوريد. فهم جيد للوائح والإجراءات التنظيمية المتعلقة بالمشتريات. القدرة على التعامل مع عمليات الشراء المباشر والمناقصات. مهارات تدقيق المطالبات المالية ومتابعة استلام المشتريات. بيئة العمل يعمل مندوب المشتريات في فندق فرج المدينة الفندقية بالمدينة المنورة ضمن فريق مخصص، ويكون مسؤولاً عن دعم العمليات التشغيلية للفندق. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع. ملخص الوظيفة تتضمن هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية شراء المواد والسلع، ومتابعة استلام المشتريات ومطابقة الكميات والمواصفات، بالإضافة إلى تدقيق المطالبات المالية وإعداد التقارير اللازمة. يساهم شاغل الوظيفة في ضمان كفاءة وفعالية عمليات الشراء في الفندق.

be4ab76a725392b1.job_title: Manager - Health Safety and Welfare Operations (RD 4)
be4ab76a725392b1.description: Job Summary Lead and manage worker welfare delivery across completed, occupied assets city-wide, ensuring safe, dignified and compliant living conditions for employees and contractor workforces. Drive consistent welfare standards and service quality across multiple sites covering accommodation, catering/food services (where applicable), transport, hygiene, recreation and wellbeing services, aligned with legal, client and company requirements. Partner with Operations, Facilities Management, HSE, HR, Security, Transport and service providers to prevent welfare issues, respond to grievances, investigate concerns, and deliver corrective actions. Maintain strong site presence across the city portfolio, use audits and KPIs to drive continuous improvement, and report performance, risks and resident/community interface considerations to operations leadership. Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities Key Responsibilities (Summary) Own and maintain the Worker Welfare Management Plan for the completed-assets, city-wide portfolio, ensuring consistent standards across sites and shifts in steady-state operations. Plan and execute routine multi-site welfare inspections and audits (internal, client and regulatory) covering accommodation, water quality, sanitation, pest control, housekeeping, security interfaces, transport and recreational facilities; maintain audit readiness and close findings on time. Manage welfare-related service providers and FM partners city-wide (accommodation operations, cleaning, catering/retail where applicable, transport, security, laundry and maintenance): define requirements, monitor SLAs/KPIs, lead performance reviews, and drive corrective and preventive actions. Support labour standards and site rules compliance: worker induction and periodic refreshers on welfare services, conduct expectations within occupied communities, and reporting channels; coordinate remediation with HR and contractor management. Operate grievance and escalation channels (including confidential routes) and support the interface with service requests/complaints relevant to welfare in occupied assets; ensure timely triage, investigation, response and close-out; identify trends and implement preventative actions. Maintain city-wide welfare performance dashboards and reporting (audit results, grievances, service quality, occupancy, inspections, non-conformances and corrective actions); chair/participate in management reviews with Operations and FM, and provide client updates as required. Lead and develop the welfare team across a dispersed city footprint (e.g., welfare officers, site/camp supervisors/inspectors) by setting clear roles, training, and ensuring effective coverage and escalation across sites. Ensure compliance with applicable legal, municipal and client welfare requirements; maintain records and evidence packs for inspections/audits; coordinate with HSE, HR and FM partners on related obligations and corrective actions. Plan welfare readiness for steady-state city operations and peak demand periods (seasonality/events): accommodation capacity and allocations, transport routing, service volumes, consumables, and contingency plans for heat stress, outbreaks, utility interruptions or supplier failures. Bachelor’s degree in Social Sciences, Public Health, Occupational Health & Safety, Facilities Management, Hospitality Management, or a related discipline. Training/certification in worker welfare, labour standards, social compliance, HSE, auditing, or facilities management (e.g., social compliance auditor training, NEBOSH/IOSH, ISO auditing) is preferred. 8+ years’ experience in worker welfare, accommodation/camp operations, social compliance, facilities/property operations, or workforce services within large, multi-site (city-wide) operational environments. Demonstrated capability in multi-site auditing and close-out of corrective actions, vendor/SLA management, grievance handling, stakeholder engagement in occupied assets, and using data to improve service quality and workforce wellbeing. Proactive, self-directed and able to work independently across a dispersed portfolio, using initiative to identify issues early, drive improvements and follow through to closure.

be3c0caea97073f8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المشير الحديثة للحراسات الأمنية عن مراقب كاميرات أمنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على أنظمة المراقبة الأمنية لضمان سلامة المنشأة والاستجابة الفورية للحالات الطارئة. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على عمليات كاميرات المراقبة والتعامل مع حالات الإنذار وطوارئ الحرائق والتحقيق فيها، مع ضمان الاستجابة الفورية على مدار الساعة. تشغيل أنظمة الإنذار وكاميرات المراقبة ومراقبتها وصيانتها بشكل دوري. تنزيل التسجيلات وإدارتها لاستخدامها في التحقيقات المستقبلية، مع ضمان الامتثال لقواعد ولوائح خصوصية البيانات. التحقيق في الحالات الطارئة وانتهاكات السياسات والإجراءات الأمنية المتبعة. اتباع السياسات والإجراءات التي تتوافق مع القوانين واللوائح الأمنية، وإبلاغ الإدارة بالمشكلات عند حدوثها. رفع التقارير المتعلقة بالأسباب والنتائج للإدارة، وتقديم التوصيات بمسار العمل المناسب. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال مراقبة الكاميرات الأمنية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تشغيل وصيانة أنظمة المراقبة والإنذار. معرفة جيدة بقواعد ولوائح خصوصية البيانات المتعلقة بالتسجيلات الأمنية. مهارات جيدة في التحقيق وإعداد التقارير. بيئة العمل يعمل مراقب الكاميرات الأمنية في مدينة الرياض، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب اليقظة والاستجابة السريعة للحفاظ على الأمن. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات الأمنية الصارمة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة المشير الحديثة للحراسات الأمنية.

be19edc716af07ef.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة القسي العالمية للمقاولات عن فني دعم تقنية معلومات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم الفني والمساعدة للموظفين والعملاء في حل المشكلات المتعلقة بتقنية المعلومات، وتحديد المتطلبات اللازمة لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم الدعم الفني والمساعدة للموظفين والعملاء الذين يواجهون مشاكل في تقنية المعلومات، والرد على استفساراتهم بهدف حل المشكلات التقنية. تحديد الأدوات والمستلزمات المطلوبة لأعمال دعم الموظفين والعملاء وحل المشاكل، ورفع النواقص إلى المعنيين لتأمينها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. توفير المعلومات الفنية المتعلقة بأجهزة ونظم وبرامج تقنية المعلومات، والتصعيد إلى أخصائيي تقنية المعلومات عند الحاجة لمشكلات معقدة. حفظ وتبويب البيانات والمعلومات المتعلقة بعمليات الدعم الفني المقدمة، بالاستناد إلى الممارسات المعتمدة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال دعم تقنية المعلومات. القدرة على تشخيص وحل المشكلات التقنية المتعلقة بالأجهزة والبرامج. معرفة جيدة بأنظمة التشغيل الشائعة وتطبيقات المكتب. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم الدعم الفني بوضوح وفعالية. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. مهارات تنظيمية عالية والقدرة على إعداد التقارير. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب تقديم الدعم الفني المستمر. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

be6749ac027100e8.description: نبذة عن الشركة والدور TruckMate Information Technology هي منشأة سعودية تقنية مقرها الدمام، متخصصة في تطوير نظام ERP متكامل لشركات النقل والخدمات اللوجستية. يغطي النظام جوانب متعددة مثل إسناد الرحلات، التتبع المباشر للأسطول، سندات التسليم الإلكترونية، إدارة الورشة وقطع الغيار، والموارد البشرية والرواتب. تبحث الشركة عن مندوب مبيعات ميداني للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينتي الدمام والرياض، بخبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. مهام الوظيفة يتولى مندوب المبيعات الميداني مسؤولية تعريف الشركات المستهدفة بنظام TruckMate ومتابعتها حتى إتمام توقيع العقود. تشمل المهام الرئيسية ما يلي: بناء قائمة بالشركات المستهدفة في المنطقة المحددة، والوصول إلى صناع القرار فيها. زيارة الشركات ميدانياً لفهم طريقة إدارتها لأسطولها وعملياتها. ترتيب وتقديم عروض تجريبية للنظام بدعم من فريق TruckMate. متابعة العملاء المحتملين حتى مرحلة التفاوض وتوقيع العقد. تسجيل الزيارات والعملاء في سجل المتابعة، وإرسال تقرير يومي مختصر. تحقيق المستهدفات الأسبوعية من الزيارات والعروض التجريبية. نقل ملاحظات العملاء من الميدان للمساهمة في تطوير النظام. المؤهلات والمتطلبات لشغل هذا الدور، يجب أن تتوفر في المرشح المؤهلات والمتطلبات التالية: خبرة في المبيعات، ويفضل أن تكون في قطاع النقل أو الخدمات اللوجستية أو مبيعات الأنظمة. وجود علاقات مع شركات نقل أو مقاولات أو توزيع يعتبر ميزة إضافية. رخصة قيادة سارية وسيارة خاصة. القدرة على العمل باستقلالية في الميدان. طبيعة العمل والمزايا تتميز طبيعة العمل بالمرونة، حيث يتم توثيق العقد عبر منصة قوى. يوفر الدور عمولة مجزية على كل عقد يتم توقيعه، مع دخل مفتوح بدون سقف، وحرية في تنظيم الوقت وجدول الزيارات. كما يتم توفير تدريب كامل على النظام، وحساب تجريبي للعروض، وملفات تعريفية جاهزة لدعم مندوب المبيعات. تفاصيل إضافية هذا الدور متاح بنظام العقد، ويقدم راتباً يتراوح بين 5,625 ريال سعودي و 7,500 ريال سعودي.

Known for exceptional food, warm hospitality, and executing simple things beautifully, this upscale kitchen is looking for a driven culinary professional to bridge the gap between the pass and the team. The Role As a Junior Sous Chef, you will support the Sous Chef and Head Chef in daily kitchen management. You will serve as both a technical anchor and an emerging leader—overseeing preparation, maintaining rigorous standards, and stepping up to run the line when the team needs you most. Your Profile & Experience Experience: 3 to 4 years of solid kitchen background, including at least 1 to 2 years as a Chef de Partie or Junior Sous Chef within a fine dining or upscale environment. Foundation: Strong technical culinary skills paired with a keen eye for consistency, organization, and clear leadership potential. Traits: Disciplined, adaptable, and highly consistent. High-volume services do not shake your composure; you stay focused, set the right tone, and keep the team moving forward. Language: English fluency is mandatory. Additional language skills such as French or Arabic are highly advantageous. Core Responsibilities Technical Excellence & Standards: Oversee food preparation, cooking, and plating to ensure absolute precision, consistency, and quality across every section during every service. Leadership & Mentoring: Motivate, train, and support the kitchen brigade, leading by example and stepping in to command the kitchen operations when necessary. Hygiene & Safety: Strictly enforce food safety and hygiene protocols across all stations, ensuring a compliant and spotless working environment at all times. Organization & Adaptability: Manage inventory control, stock rotation, and kitchen flow, seamlessly adjusting to the shifting demands of busy services.

bec43c25e7b369bd.description: General Accountant — 1 to 2 years of experience A company specializing in corporate services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia is announcing a vacancy for a General Accountant to contribute to organizing daily financial operations, ensuring the accuracy of records, and preparing reports that support performance monitoring and decision-making. Tasks and Responsibilities: Recording daily journal entries, reviewing documents and invoices, and performing accounting classification. Monitoring customer and supplier accounts, collections, payables, and payment schedules. Issuing service invoices and following up on collections in coordination with the relevant departments. Monitoring expenses, petty cash, and advances, and performing necessary reconciliations. Preparing bank reconciliations and matching balances regularly. Monitoring service revenues and costs and contributing to the preparation of profitability reports. Contributing to monthly closings and preparing periodic financial reports. Preparing data and documents necessary for Zakat and tax purposes in coordination with the financial advisor. Organizing the financial archive and maintaining data confidentiality. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, or equivalent. 1 to 2 years of practical experience in general accounting, preferably in service companies. Proficiency in using Excel and accounting software; experience with the Odoo system is an added advantage. Familiarity with the fundamentals of Value Added Tax (VAT) and electronic invoicing in Saudi Arabia. Accuracy in data entry and review, and the ability to organize work and meet deadlines. Good communication, follow-up, and teamwork skills.

This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah Province, and requires an individual to serve as the primary ambassador for the company, ensuring smooth office workflows and a professional welcome for all visitors. Role Purpose The Receptionist serves as the initial point of contact for Middle East Mattress Factory Co., managing all front-desk activities. beb1809f2d524e92.description: About the Role GREENLAND GROUP is seeking a Production Engineer specializing in Thermoforming for a full-time position in Saudi Arabia. This role, associated with AL RASHID DIRECT COMPANY, involves overseeing and optimizing thermoforming production processes. The role involves monitoring business performance, conducting competitive analysis, and supporting digital marketing campaigns in the Saudi market. Position: Business Analyst Summary: The position requires a candidate to monitor business performance, conduct competitive analysis, support digital marketing campaigns, coordinate project launches, and manage stakeholder relationships. Responsibilities: Monitor the performance of Digital Virgo's digital services through key business and marketing KPIs (traffic, conversion, subscriptions, revenue, churn, customer acquisition, retention, ROI, etc.). Analyze business performance and identify optimization opportunities to improve profitability. Conduct competitive analysis, benchmark market trends, and identify new growth opportunities within the Saudi digital ecosystem. Support the planning and execution of digital marketing campaigns across acquisition channels. Coordinate the launch of new digital services and marketing initiatives. Requirements: Bachelor or Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or a related field 2-5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Business Analysis, Product Marketing, Digital Services, Telecom, Mobile Payments, VAS, FinTech, or a similar digital environment. Strong analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail. Ability to interpret business data and transform it into actionable recommendations. Comfortable working with KPIs, dashboards, and performance reporting. Advanced Excel skills; experience with Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar BI tools is an advantage. Good understanding of digital marketing channels and customer acquisition. Knowledge of subscription-based digital services is a plus. Ability to analyze campaign performance and recommend improvements. Strong organizational and coordination skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Experience using Jira or similar project management tools. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively with multicultural and cross-functional teams. Strong presentation skills.

be3bf4a14e0ce902.description: About the Role ADB Safegate is seeking a Heavy Driver to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time position involves providing general assistance and support to technical teams, focusing on corrective and preventive maintenance activities for Airfield Lighting, A-VDGS, CCTV equipment, and related airport infrastructure. The role requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Execute work orders as assigned by Maintenance Management and Officers/Engineers, including airside operations. Assist in the emergency replacement of broken equipment (corrective maintenance) or according to scheduled preventive maintenance plans. Participate in general custodial maintenance services to ensure the acceptable appearance of Airfield Lighting, A-VDGS, and CCTV facilities. Perform maintenance tasks in the workshop during stand-by service or planned maintenance activities. Conduct disassembly, inspection, part replacement, reassembly, and checks of equipment such as lighting fixtures, constant current regulators, A-VDGS, and CCTV. Work in shifts (morning/afternoon/night) as defined by Officers/Engineers. Participate in training sessions to maintain and enhance competencies. Perform general cleaning and maintenance tasks for vehicles, equipment, and tools, including inspections, fluid checks and replacements, greasing, and cleaning of work areas. Exercise necessary care and caution when handling and operating equipment (MEWP) and tools, adhering to airport-specific safety policies and responsibilities concerning safety, prevention, reporting, and monitoring. Required Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Knowledge of the principles, practices, methods, materials, and tools used in maintenance, installation, and repair. Understanding of hazards and safety precautions associated with aircraft operations and high voltage airfield lighting systems. Skills and Abilities Adaptability to work effectively in a multinational and multicultural environment. Ability to work a non-traditional, flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays. Capacity to remain alert and aware to prevent injuries or accidents. Ability to act effectively in emergency situations or under pressure with minimal guidance. Strong ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues and airport operators. Work Environment This role operates within the airport environment, requiring adherence to strict safety protocols and potentially involving work in various weather conditions and during non-standard hours. The position is based in Dammam, Eastern Region. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this full-time position.

be887d70c7f37725.job_title: Integration Operations Engineer (HL7/Mirth Connect) - Saudi National
be887d70c7f37725.description: About the Company Astek Middle East is part of Astek, a global engineering and technology consulting group founded in France in 1988 and now present on five continents. The Middle East entity delivers IT and technology services across Saudi Arabia, the Emirates, and Jordan, supporting clients in public and government, healthcare, transportation, banking, retail, airlines, and tourism. With 10,000 employees worldwide and revenue of €620 million in 2023, Astek focuses on digital transformation and complex systems engineering for international clients. The group promotes a strong culture of entrepreneurship, innovation, and continuous skills development. More information is available on the Astek Saudi Arabia and Emirates country pages, and candidates can reach Astek Middle East at [Click to show email] . About the Role We are looking for a candidate of Saudi nationality with hands-on experience in healthcare systems integration to join our client’s team as an HL7 Integration Developer / Integration Operations Engineer. The successful candidate will help manage, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain healthcare integration interfaces, ensuring reliable data exchange between systems. The role involves working with Mirth Connect (NextGen Integration Engine), HL7 and FHIR standards, APIs, message queues, and cross-functional technical teams to maintain stable integration services. Candidates with 4+ years of relevant experience and practical knowledge of healthcare integration environments are encouraged to apply. Key Responsibilities Manage and monitor Mirth Connect channels and message queues across different environments. Perform message reprocessing, error handling, and troubleshooting for failed interfaces. Investigate integration issues and support timely resolution to maintain system stability and reliability. Support the onboarding of new integrations and assist developers with interface deployment. Work closely with DevOps and Database Administration (DBA) teams to maintain smooth end-to-end data flow. Monitor integration performance and identify issues affecting message processing and interface reliability. Document integration procedures, channel configurations, troubleshooting steps, and operational standards. Support continuous improvement of integration operations and healthcare data exchange processes. Requirements Saudi nationality is mandatory. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field. 4+ years of relevant professional experience in integration development, integration operations, or healthcare systems integration. Hands-on experience with Mirth Connect (NextGen Integration Engine) or similar integration platforms. Strong understanding of HL7 and FHIR healthcare data standards. Knowledge of REST and SOAP APIs. Practical experience with message queue management, channel monitoring, error handling, and troubleshooting. Ability to investigate integration failures and support reliable end-to-end data exchange. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Previous experience working in healthcare integration environments. Experience supporting the deployment and onboarding of new interfaces. Familiarity with integration procedures, channel configurations, and operational documentation. Experience collaborating with DevOps, DBA, and development teams. Location & Candidate Preference This position is based in Al Qassim, Saudi Arabia . Saudi nationals currently residing in Al Qassim will be given preference. Saudi nationals from other locations who are willing to relocate to Al Qassim are also welcome to apply. If you have hands-on experience with healthcare integration platforms, HL7 standards, and integration troubleshooting, we encourage you to apply with your updated CV.

beadc1a8d86d299a.description: Locations : Dubai | Riyadh | Doha Who We Are Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. What You'll Do As the HR Risk and Employee Relations (ER) CoE Manager in this 12- 14 m onth temporary role , you will play a strategic role in shaping the HR Risk and Employee Relations framework for the organisation in the Middle East. You will drive the development and implementation of policies, lead high-impact employee relations initiatives, and act as a key advisor to a senior leadership on complex workplace matters. In this capacity you will own critical HR processes, including ER investigations. You will act as a trusted advisor to HR services, and partner to business leaders, and employees, offering expert guidance on best practices in employee relations, workplace conduct, and HR risk management. Collaborating with legal, compliance, and HR teams, you will proactively address potential risks, enhance employee experience, and foster a culture of accountability and transparency. YOU'RE GOOD AT Employee Relations and Conflict Resolution Managing sensitive ER cases, including investigations into grievances, misconduct, and workplace conflicts, ensuring fair and compliant resolutions. Providing guidance and support on complex ER matters, acting as a subject matter expert. Proactively identifying potential workplace issues and addressing them through preventative measures, such as training or policy updates. Maintain Middle East case data up to date in the relevant tools; documenting conversations and preparing high quality reports. Lead the analysis of trends and data insights on cases, outcomes and recommendations throughout the year. Through the analysis and interpretation of internal and external ER related data sources, identify trends and develop appropriate recommendations for value adding and strategic ER interventions that meet organizational and customer specific needs. Ensure the impacts of these initiatives are measurable and evidenced. Policy Development and Implementation Owning and developing HR policies and processes related to employee relations, workplace conduct, and HR risk management. Collaborating with HR leadership to align policies with organizational objectives and compliance requirements. Ensuring that all policies are effectively communicated and understood across the organization. Drive efficiency improvements through offshoring/outsourcing solutions, and the application of technology. Knowledge Building and HR Support Supporting the HR Services team by providing structural solutions and knowledge-sharing initiatives to enhance team capabilities in handling challenging discussions. Developing resources, including clearly structured and complete templates, as well as training programs to improve the HR Services team’s and other stakeholder proficiency in managing processes independently where possible. Ensure awareness and compliance with BCG values, enabling a welcoming and non threatening work environment for all our staff and other contributors. Acting as a liaison between HR Services and other functions to address escalated issues and align on resolutions. Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement Building strong relationships with HR Services, other HR CoE teams to drive alignment on ER and risk-related matters. Acting as a trusted partner to employees, managers, and leadership by providing guidance and ensuring fair treatment in all workplace matters. Representing the organization in interactions with regulatory bodies or external auditors when required What You'll Bring Bachelor’s degree in HR Management or Business. Educational Background in employment law or demonstrable practical experience with handling complex employment/workplace issues with a legal angle. 7 years of professional experience in HR operations, employee relations, or HR risk management. Experience in employee relations (mandatory for the role). Strong understanding of workplace policies, and risk management frameworks. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with an approach to addressing HR challenges. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to handle sensitive issues with discretion and professionalism. Collaborative mindset, with the ability to work effectively across teams & with diverse stakeholders. Your written and spoken English is excellent, Arabic is a plus Who You'll Work With You will collaborate closely with HR Services, legal and compliance teams to manage risk and employee relations effectively. The ideal candidate must have over three years of direct student counselling experience, particularly within the expatriate market and with Saudi-sponsored students. The role involves managing student enquiries, providing guidance on global university admissions, converting prospective students into enrolments, and supporting the branch's recruitment objectives across multiple international study destinations. Key Responsibilities Counsel students on university and course options across global destinations, including the UK, Europe, and other international markets. Manage the complete admissions process, from initial enquiry and application to offer acceptance and enrolment. Provide tailored guidance to expatriate students and Saudi-sponsored applicants. Review academic documents and ensure applications meet university requirements. Follow up with applicants and university admissions teams to secure offers and successful enrolments.
